title: stellaria media var. micrantha
intro: Stellaria media var. micrantha, commonly known as lesser celandine, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Caryophyllaceae family. This perennial plant is native to Europe and Asia and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, as well as its ability to treat digestive issues and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Stellaria media var. micrantha include its use as an antipyretic, diuretic, and expectorant, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating fever, urinary issues, and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential in treating various diseases.
